description: This Java class 'WebToolsServices' provides a collection of server-side service methods related to entity management within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities such as importing/exporting entity data, parsing XML configurations, generating Entity-Relationship models, security permission checks, and service artifact management, facilitating development and administrative tasks for entity handling.

classes.name: WebToolsServices
classes.description: A utility class providing WebTools related services for managing entities, including import/export, parsing, security checks, and model generation within OFBiz framework.

methods.name: entityImport
methods.description: Imports entities from an XML file or URL, parses it, and processes the data into the system.

methods.name: entityImportDir
methods.description: Imports multiple entity XML files from a specified directory, with options for filtering and processing, including delete after import.

methods.name: entityImportReaders
methods.description: Imports entity data from a list of data readers, supporting data check and load modes.

methods.name: parseEntityXmlFile
methods.description: Parses an individual entity XML file or text, returning the number of entities processed.

methods.name: entityExportAll
methods.description: Exports all entity data to XML files in a specified directory, with optional date filtering.

methods.name: getEntityRefData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about entities, including fields, relations, and indexes, structured by package.

methods.name: exportEntityEoModelBundle
methods.description: Exports entity model data into an Enterprise Object Model (EOM) bundle at specified path.

methods.name: entityMaintPermCheck
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform entity maintenance actions.

methods.name: exportServiceEoModelBundle
methods.description: Exports service call graph into an EOM bundle for entity services.
